units.source_text: 錢嘛……」「好啊，錢沒關係的。」她開心地起身離去。

en.t: As for the money... "All right, the money does not matter." She happily got up and left.

units.source_text: 吩咐女人辦事，絕對不會讓她們感到無趣，如果男人拜託女人去做事，她們反而很開心。

en.t: Giving women errands never makes them feel bored; if a man asks a woman to do something, they are happy instead.

units.source_text: 這種事我最清楚不過了。

en.t: I understood that sort of thing better than anyone.

units.source_text: 另一個女人是高等女子師範大學的文科生，是一位所謂的「同志」。

en.t: The other woman was a literature student at the Higher Women's Normal University, a so-called comrade.

units.source_text: 因地下運動的緣故，無論願意與否，我每天都不得不與她碰面。

en.t: Because of the underground movement, whether I wanted to or not, I had to meet her every day.

units.source_text: 碰面結束後，這個女人總是緊隨我身後，不停地給我買這買那。

en.t: After our meetings were over, this woman would always follow close behind me and keep buying me this and that.

units.source_text: 「你就把我當作你的親姐姐好啦。」

en.t: "Just think of me as your real older sister."

units.source_text: 她這種假惺惺的做作腔調聽得我直起雞皮疙瘩。

en.t: Hearing that affected, self-satisfied tone of hers made goose bumps rise all over me.
